input.summary: Ported fir.cu to SYCL 2020 in port/fir.sycl.cpp. It has no dpct includes, DPCT macros or dpct:: helpers, and compiles with icpx -fsycl with 0 errors and 0 warnings, with --add_dpct_include=false. Design: USM device buffers (malloc_device/free), a 1-D nd_range of 256-item groups, a local_accessor for the 319-sample tile, group_barrier for the tile sync, and the 64 taps passed by value in a std::array captured by the kernel (replacing __constant__ memory). Errors are reported via sycl::exception. Caveat: I have not run the binary or compared its output against the CUDA reference, so the -96 dBFS null test is still unverified. The toolset available here has no run/verify tool. Note also that the kernel reads taps[k] per work-item from the by-value argument; this matches the original arithmetic order, so results should match, but this needs confirmation by the verify step.
